text:
maria: quick heads-up — we need runtime + infra signals for the new visibility modes in the console. thinking: internal-only metrics, customer-facing aggregates, and an audit trail for changes. Who can give a list of available signals?

jay: @maria I can start a catalog. runtime exposes per-request latency, gpu_ms, kv_cache_hit, and quantized_model flag. not all are safe to show to customers (gpu_ms is fine, but internal model variant IDs are sensitive).

sasha: from runtime side: we can add a 'visibility' tag to spans and metrics. would add ~2ms to path if we emit extra tags, should be fine. can also emit per-tenant route_id and rollout_flag.

leo: infra: we have per-node telemetry (cpu, mem, scheduling_wait) and per-pool capacity metrics. retention for high-res traces is 30d, infra logs 90d. audit logs are stored in a separate S3 bucket with immutability policy.

anya: security: audit logs must include actor, action, resource, timestamp, and request_id. For customer-facing dashboards we must scrub any customer PII and remove model-internal ids. Export endpoints for audit data must be restricted to SOC approve roles.

maria: +1. UX question: product wants a toggle in dashboard "show internal details" that only admins can flip. Also sharing links that expire and have view-only vs edit scopes. Thoughts on permission model?

jay: suggest role matrix: viewer, editor, admin, auditor. viewer=customer default (cannot see internal-only metrics), editor=can create saved charts, admin=manage sharing & RBAC, auditor=read-only across tenants (for ops). Map to SSO groups.

anya: auditor role needs access to audit trail but not the full internal debug traces. We should differentiate "audit records" vs "debug traces" in storage and access controls.

sasha: technical note: per-request token_cost is computed in the runtime post-processing step; we can emit token_breakdown and prefix_cache_savings. token_breakdown might reveal prompt contents if we attach token-level deltas — we should only expose aggregated counts.

leo: for quota dashboards we can provide both live consumption and projected burn rate. Infra can surface per-tenant quota usage via a lightweight API: GET /internal/tenants/{id}/quota?window=1h. Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL" https://telemetry.internal/tenants/abc123/quota?window=1h
{
  "used_tokens": 142345,
  "limit_tokens": 1000000,
  "burn_rate_per_hour": 5400
}
```

maria: perfect. For sharing we want ephemeral links with limited scopes. proposal: signed URL + scope param + expiry. shareable links should be logged to audit bucket with actor.

jay: implementation detail: console will call backend to mint token, backend returns short-lived JWT with claims: {scope, resources, exp}. store mapping in audit index for lookup.

anya: must ensure JWTs are opaque in logs (no payload) and only store reference id in audit. actual JWT decoding requires admin privileges.

sasha: can we tag metrics emitted by canary/rollout so dashboards can filter by release? we'll add release_tag to the metrics stream.

maria: product asks: can customers create derived dashboards from internal metrics (aggregates only)? we should allow aggregation (avg, p50/p95) but not raw trace links.

leo: export formats: CSV for aggregates, NDJSON for audit. retention/archival policy must be in RFC. I'll raise infra ticket for export ACLs.

jay: action items: (1) runtime: add visibility tag + release_tag + aggregated token metrics (sasha) (2) infra: expose lightweight quota API + export ACLs (leo) (3) security: finalize audit schema + JWT policy (anya) (4) product/console: UX for toggle, sharing flow, role mapping (maria/jay).

maria: can we get ETA for each?

sasha: runtime changes — prefactor + rollout, ~2 sprints.

leo: infra APIs + export ACLs — 3 sprints; audit bucket immutability in place today so that part is immediate.

anya: audit schema review — 1 sprint. I'll add privacy checklist for customer-visible aggregates.

jay: console UI + RBAC mapping — depends on backend, estimate 2 sprints after APIs.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short RFC and link to this thread. please add any blockers below.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: telemetry-service v3.9.1 -> prod at 16:45 UTC :rocket:

maria: noted. tagging RFC with @eng-runtime @eng-infra @eng-security.

jay: one more: add a safe-mode for shared dashboards so if a user tries to share a dashboard containing internal-only panels we block and suggest a redacted version. We can implement server-side validation: check panel.sources for internal flag and remove.

anya: agreed — validation should run on minting share token. log reason in audit.

maria: ok next steps: I'll create RFC + spreadsheet of metrics mapping to visibility categories. posting link shortly. :white_check_mark:
